sql:
WITH bf_lines AS (
  SELECT
    o.orderid,
    ol.quantity * ol.unitprice AS line_value,
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM wideworldimporters.sales.specialdeals sd
      WHERE o.orderdate >= sd.startdate
        AND (sd.enddate IS NULL OR o.orderdate <= sd.enddate)
        AND (
          sd.customerid = o.customerid
          OR sd.buyinggroupid = c.buyinggroupid
          OR sd.customercategoryid = c.customercategoryid
        )
        AND (
          sd.stockitemid = ol.stockitemid
          OR sd.stockgroupid IN (
            SELECT sisg.stockgroupid
            FROM wideworldimporters.warehouse.stockitemstockgroups sisg
            WHERE sisg.stockitemid = ol.stockitemid
          )
        )
    ) AS promo_line
  FROM wideworldimporters.sales.orders o
  JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.customers c ON c.customerid = o.customerid
  JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.orderlines ol ON ol.orderid = o.orderid
  WHERE o.orderdate >= DATE '2024-11-29'
    AND o.orderdate < DATE '2024-11-30'
),
order_totals AS (
  SELECT
    orderid,
    SUM(line_value) AS order_value,
    BOOL_OR(promo_line) AS has_promotion
  FROM bf_lines
  GROUP BY orderid
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN has_promotion THEN 'With promotion' ELSE 'Without promotion' END AS promotion_group,
  COUNT(*) AS order_count,
  AVG(order_value) AS average_order_value
FROM order_totals
GROUP BY has_promotion
ORDER BY has_promotion DESC
LIMIT 500

sql:
SELECT sd.specialdealid,
       sd.dealdescription,
       SUM(il.extendedprice) AS total_sales_revenue
FROM wideworldimporters.sales.specialdeals sd
JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.invoices i
  ON i.invoicedate BETWEEN sd.startdate AND sd.enddate
JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.invoicelines il
  ON il.invoiceid = i.invoiceid
JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.customers c
  ON c.customerid = i.customerid
WHERE (sd.customerid IS NULL OR sd.customerid = c.customerid)
  AND (sd.buyinggroupid IS NULL OR sd.buyinggroupid = c.buyinggroupid)
  AND (sd.customercategoryid IS NULL OR sd.customercategoryid = c.customercategoryid)
  AND (sd.stockitemid IS NULL OR sd.stockitemid = il.stockitemid)
  AND (sd.stockgroupid IS NULL OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM wideworldimporters.warehouse.stockitemstockgroups sisg
        WHERE sisg.stockitemid = il.stockitemid
          AND sisg.stockgroupid = sd.stockgroupid))
GROUP BY sd.specialdealid, sd.dealdescription
ORDER BY total_sales_revenue DESC
LIMIT 1

sql:
SELECT o.orderid, ol.orderlineid, o.customerid, o.orderdate, ol.stockitemid, ol.description, ol.quantity, ol.unitprice, ol.taxrate, sd.specialdealid, sd.dealdescription, sd.discountamount, sd.discountpercentage, sd.unitprice AS dealunitprice, sd.startdate, sd.enddate
FROM wideworldimporters.sales.orders o
JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.orderlines ol ON ol.orderid = o.orderid
JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.customers c ON c.customerid = o.customerid
JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.specialdeals sd
  ON o.orderdate BETWEEN sd.startdate AND sd.enddate
  AND (sd.stockitemid IS NULL OR sd.stockitemid = ol.stockitemid)
  AND (sd.stockgroupid IS NULL OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM wideworldimporters.warehouse.stockitemstockgroups sisg
    WHERE sisg.stockitemid = ol.stockitemid AND sisg.stockgroupid = sd.stockgroupid))
  AND (sd.customerid IS NULL OR sd.customerid = o.customerid)
  AND (sd.buyinggroupid IS NULL OR sd.buyinggroupid = c.buyinggroupid)
  AND (sd.customercategoryid IS NULL OR sd.customercategoryid = c.customercategoryid)
ORDER BY o.orderid, ol.orderlineid, sd.specialdealid
